entries.title: Job 38:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: Who [is] this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me. {answer...: Heb. make me know}

words.text: thou me. {answer...: Heb. make me know}

entries.title: Job 38:4
segments: ¶Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding. {hast...: Heb. knowest understanding}

words.text: wast thou when I laid the foundations

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof; {foundations: Heb. sockets} {fastened: Heb. made to sink?}

words.text: thereof; {foundations: Heb. sockets} {fastened: Heb. made to sink?}

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, [as if] it had issued out of the womb?

entries.title: Job 38:9
segments: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

entries.title: Job 38:10
segments: And brake up for it my decreed [place], and set bars and doors, {brake...: or, established my decree upon it}

words.text: , {brake...: or, established my decree upon it}

entries.title: Job 38:11
segments: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed? {thy...: Heb. the pride of thy waves}

words.text: ? {thy...: Heb. the pride of thy waves}

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: ¶Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; [and] caused the dayspring to know his place;

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it? {ends: Heb. wings}

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments: It is turned as clay [to] the seal; and they stand as a garment.

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

words.text: unto thee? or hast thou seen

entries.title: Job 38:18
segments: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: Where [is] the way [where] light dwelleth? and [as for] darkness, where [is] the place thereof,

entries.title: Job 38:20
segments: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths [to] the house thereof? {to the bound: or, at, etc}

words.text: thereof, and that thou shouldest know
thereof? {to the bound: or, at, etc}

entries.title: Job 38:21
segments: Knowest thou [it], because thou wast then born? or [because] the number of thy days [is] great?

words.text: thou [it], because thou wast then born

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: By what way is the light parted, [which] scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: ¶Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

entries.title: Job 38:26
segments: To cause it to rain on the earth, [where] no man [is; on] the wilderness, wherein [there is] no man;

entries.title: Job 38:27
segments: To satisfy the desolate and waste [ground]; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

entries.title: Job 38:28
segments: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

entries.title: Job 38:29
segments: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: The waters are hid as [with] a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen. {is...: Heb. is taken}

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion? {Pleiades: or, the seven stars: Heb. Cimah} {Orion: Heb. Cesil?}

words.text: ? {Pleiades: or, the seven stars: Heb. Cimah} {Orion: Heb. Cesil?}

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons? {Mazzaroth: or, the twelve signs} {guide: Heb. guide them}

words.text: ? {Mazzaroth: or, the twelve signs} {guide: Heb. guide them}

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:34
segments: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

entries.title: Job 38:35
segments: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we [are]? {Here...: Heb. Behold us?}

words.text: unto thee, Here we [are]? {Here...: Heb. Behold us?}

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven, {stay: Heb. cause to lie down}

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together? {groweth...: or, is turned into mire: Heb. is poured}

words.text: ? {groweth...: or, is turned into mire: Heb. is poured}

entries.title: Job 38:39
segments: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions, {the appetite: Heb. the life}

entries.title: Job 38:40
segments: When they couch in [their] dens, [and] abide in the covert to lie in wait?

entries.title: Job 38:41
segments: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
